items.text: New England (final report, Munich): OUT - RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness), C/G Ben Brown (knee), CB Carlton Davis III (knee). QUESTIONABLE - WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee; Vrabel says he and Stevenson looked 'pretty good'), RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee), CB Charles Woods (hamstring), OL Greg Van Roten (hamstring), FB Reggie Gilliam (knee), S Kevin Byard (chest), S Brenden Schooler (hamstring), OL Walter Rouse (concussion), TE Cameron Latu (back). Drake Maye starts.
items.source: CBS Sports (NFL Week 10 injury report: final game statuses, Nov 13)

items.text: Detroit (final report): OUT - S Kerby Joseph (knee), CB D.J. Reed (hip), C Cade Mays (ankle). QUESTIONABLE - WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (rib), RB Sione Vaki (ankle). IR - LB Jack Campbell, CB Thomas Harper, RB Isiah Pacheco. Jared Goff (chest) not designated, starts.
items.source: CBS Sports (NFL Week 10 injury report: final game statuses, Nov 13)
